title: AI Will Invent a Statistic and Say It With Total Confidence
description: Our AI wrote a draft with six statistics and no sources. Our checker blocked it and caught five. How to check every number before you post.
ogDescription: A real AI draft with six confident, unsourced numbers. Our checker caught five. Here's the habit that catches the sixth.

author: Nick
